title: Game of Life
description: Update the grid based on 4 rules: underpopulation (live < 2), survival (2 or 3), overpopulation (live > 3), reproduction (dead == 3). Use -1 for dead->live and 2 for live->dead.
pseudocode:
1. for r in rows, c in cols: 
2.   liveNeighbors = count(r, c)
3.   if board[r][c] == 1 and (liveNeighbors < 2 or liveNeighbors > 3): board[r][c] = 2
4.   if board[r][c] == 0 and liveNeighbors == 3: board[r][c] = -1
5. for r in rows, c in cols: 
6.   board[r][c] = 1 if board[r][c] > 0 else 0

steps.note: Cell [0,0] is dead, has 1 live neighbor. Stay dead.
Cell [0,1] is live, has 2 neighbors. Stays live.
Cell [1,1] is dead, has 3 live neighbors. Reproduces (marked -1).
Final sweep: replace state markers -1 and 2 to 1 and 0.
